ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels forming the interior field and 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized at the perimeter and specific focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area across both lobes. Black pixel mapping includes: a continuous border along the trailing edge and lateral tips; two symmetrical circular spots flanking the median notch; one large circular spot on the mid-left lobe; two smaller adjacent spots on the mid-right lobe; and dense mottling at the peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile. Left lobe edge shows fine-grain, low-amplitude peaks. Right lobe edge features a significant, high-amplitude semi-circular indentation (notched segment) approximately one-third distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the inner trailing edges transitioning to convex trajectories at the lateral margins towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are detected at both lateral tips. A dense cluster of approximately 12 units is visible on the left tip; a smaller cluster of approximately 5 units is visible on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark-grey linear pixel disruptions. Left lobe contains three distinct diagonal markings (parallel-ish); right lobe contains one long, thin diagonal disruption extending towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant semi-circular negative-space anomaly (missing tissue segment) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe. Small irregular nicks are visible along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Faint low-intensity orange-brown patches (diatom-like staining) are visible on the upper-left quadrant of the white fluke surface.
